title: Convergence Rates of Gaussian Process Thompson Sampling for Efficient Global Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.19925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Efficient global optimization aims to identify a global optimum of an expensive black-box function within a limited evaluation budget $N$. We investigate the convergence rates of Gaussian process Thompson sampling (GP-TS) under noiseless observations, assuming a fixed objective function in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). For Mat\'ern kernels with smoothness parameter $\nu$ in dimension $d$, we establish a worst-case expected simple-regret upper bound of $O(N^{-\nu/d}\sqrt{\log N})$ for both discrete GP-TS on sufficiently fine grids and its continuous counterpart. For the continuous implementation, we develop a nested-grid argument to control posterior sample paths over the entire domain. We further establish matching lower bounds of $\Omega(N^{-5/2}\sqrt{\log N})$ for both implementations under a fixed one-dimensional Mat\'ern-$5/2$ kernel, demonstrating that the logarithmic penalty is intrinsic to standard GP-TS in this set

translated_title: 高效全局优化中高斯过程汤普森采样的收敛速率
translated_abstract: 高效全局优化旨在在有限的评估预算 $N$ 内找到昂贵的黑盒函数的全局最优解。我们在无噪声观测条件下研究高斯过程汤普森采样（GP-TS）的收敛速率，并假设目标函数固定于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中。对于维度为 $d$、光滑度参数为 $\nu$ 的Matérn核，我们为足够精细网格上的离散GP-TS及其连续版本建立了最坏情况下期望简单遗憾上界 $O(N^{-\nu/d}\sqrt{\log N})$。对于连续实现，我们开发了一种嵌套网格论证方法来控制整个定义域上的后验样本路径。我们进一步在固定的一维Matérn-5/2核下，为两种实现建立了匹配的下界 $\Omega(N^{-5/2}\sqrt{\log N})$，证明了对数惩罚项是标准GP-TS在此类设定中的固有特性。
tldr: 本文首次在无噪声RKHS设定下为高斯过程汤普森采样建立了最坏情况简单遗憾上界 $O(N^{-\nu/d}\sqrt{\log N})$ 及匹配的下界，证明对数惩罚项是该算法的固有代价。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes worst-case simple-regret upper bounds of $O(N^{-\nu/d}\sqrt{\log N})$ for Gaussian process Thompson sampling under noiseless RKHS settings, along with matching lower bounds, demonstrating that the logarithmic penalty is intrinsic to the algorithm.
